A long opening is verified against the original same-name backing and lead PCM: the entire prefix is silence or highly correlated backing with stable sample delay and gain; subsequent lyric windows show significant added foreground. The analysis prefix is derived from uncropped score matches, all final boundaries remain within 0.5 seconds of those matches, and original audio files are preserved. First reading is displayed from zero; this display time is not a measured sung onset. No full human listening review is claimed.
